description: Tests a bedroom escape window against Ontario Building Code Article 9.9.10.1: open area of at least 0.35 m2, no dimension under 380 mm, sill height and window well clearance. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/egress-window-size-calculator?units=mm&type=casement&width=600&height=700&floor=basement&well=yes&well_clearance=600

floor.description: basement = window in a basement area; above = any other floor

height.description: Clear height of the unobstructed open portion with the window fully open (units)

sill.description: Sill height above the floor (tested only when floor is above) (units)

units.description: Units of width, height, sill and clearance

well.description: The window opens into a window well

well_clearance.description: Clearance in front of the window inside the well (units)

width.description: Clear width of the unobstructed open portion with the window fully open (units)

name: egress-window-size-calculator
title: Egress window size calculator
